annotations.title: What did this Solana transaction do?

description: Every instruction of a Solana transaction by name, with its arguments and its accounts labelled: System, Compute Budget, SPL Token, Token-2022, Associated Token and Memo instructions from their layouts, every other program's with its on-chain IDL; the calls programs made to other programs (inner instructions); SOL and token balance changes per owner; signers, compute and fees; and every account with whether it signed or was written. Use for 'what did this transaction do?', 'decode this swap', 'what were the arguments?'.
name: tx_decode
title: What did this Solana transaction do?
